subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled Control UI code-editor dependency for raw JSON5 config editing, and should that work proceed by repairing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75466 or by asking for a fresh narrower PR?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it changes a sensitive config-editing surface and adds a significant UI dependency, so maintainer product and compatibility intent should decide the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency/product surface until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Require a short design note first
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask maintainers to settle dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, and sensitive-value handling before code continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied by history to the current reveal-to-edit raw config flow and is a strong owner for the product/compatibility decision around replacing it.
